content: R3F must be loaded with dynamic import and ssr:false in Next.js to prevent hydration mismatches. Canvas element is not the LCP element but blocks the main thread during initialization, delaying LCP on mobile. Key pitfalls: mounting/unmounting is expensive (prefer visibility toggling), setState in useFrame causes unnecessary re-renders (use refs instead), creating new Vector3/objects per frame causes GC pressure, uncached textures/assets re-parse per instance (use useLoader). For performance: set frameloop=demand for non-animated scenes, keep draw calls under 1000 ideally under 200, use PerformanceMonitor + regress() to adapt quality on weaker devices. R3F v9 requires React 19; v8 requires React 18 — version mismatch is a silent build-breaking pitfall.
